verdict.rationale: Obsidian's first-party Templates core plugin lets users define pre-defined snippets and insert them into notes, and its docs say templates can carry dynamic information through template variables. That covers the core of reusable, variable-driven templates. missing for 10: explicit documentation of date and title variables specifically, evidence of applying templates automatically when creating recurring notes (e.g., linking Daily notes to a template), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can define reusable templates (with variables like date and title) and apply them when creating recurring kinds of notes

citations.quote: Templates is a core plugin that lets you insert pre-defined snippets of text into your active note.
You can add dynamic information to your templates, using template variables.
